en.the borrows: In a game/map discussion this may be a typo for the burrows, meaning lairs/dens: логова. Do not invent renters or borrowers. Keep the lending meaning only when actual borrowing/lending is described
en.r4: In an alliance/game discussion R4 is a rank identifier, not a road or prose. Keep player/display names exactly as written and preserve R4. A name followed only by a rank is identifying a player, not a sentence to creatively translate
en.thanks to: Causal phrase meaning because of / owing to: благодаря. It is not a direct expression of gratitude спасибо за. Preserve the causal relationship and do not invent the speaker's gender
en.ping someone: message/contact them, not literally call them
en.build: software build in software or bot context
en.as close as I can get it to work: the best functioning result I can achieve: лучшее, чего я могу добиться; not physical proximity
en.nifty thing: a handy or neat feature: удобная фишка
en.flag a translation: mark/report a problematic translation: пометить неудачный перевод
en.it fucks up: it messes up or malfunctions: накосячит; preserve informal profanity without adding an insult
en.whatever the fuck Google was doing: an emphatic complaint about Google's results: та хрень, которую выдавал Google; never insert твою мать
en.you're gonna have to tell me your opinio: a casual request for the listener's opinion: расскажешь мне, что думаешь; not ты обязана
en.falls onto you: in a friendly request, that part is up to you: тут я полагаюсь на тебя; not blame
en.my dear Mistress: affectionate feminine address: моя дорогая Госпожа; preserve warmth and the title
en.tongue twister: скороговорка is feminine: let me try a basic Slavic tongue twister = дай попробую простую славянскую скороговорку; use feminine adjective agreement
en.semi-skimmed: milk with some fat removed: полуобезжиренное молоко; skimmed = обезжиренное, whole = цельное. Keep these choices in the exact source order; do not invent fat percentages

ru.аркадия: In an alliance event/schedule discussion this is the game event Arcadia, not a person called Arkady. Preserve event identity and schedule times
ru.свг: In this game's alliance discussion, the alliance tag is SWG (not SVG). Preserve the established Latin tag SWG
ru.саттоу: This community's player name is Sattow. Preserve that identity and exact Latin spelling, not Sattou or Satteau
ru.икры: Ambiguous: plural calves (the lower-leg muscles) in bodily appearance, exercise, aches or privacy discussion; genitive singular roe/caviar in food or fish discussion. Choose from grammar and topic, not the food meaning by default. Do not invent fish/eggs in a body conversation
ru.в объятия: Directional into someone's arms: gather/scoop/pull someone into a hug. It is not doing an action while already in their arms (that would be в объятиях). An informal misspelling such as скребешь in this hugging phrase may mean сгребешь, scoop into your arms; use surrounding cuddling context, not a literal scratch unless scratching is actually intended
ru.про кого: Identity clarification: who are you talking about / who do you mean, not are you talking about someone. Preserve the wh-question and do not invent its referent
ru.титул: A named title/role in group management or a game, not being put in charge of an abstract quality. Retain the title as a role name when assigning someone to it
ru.обаятеля: When assigning a group/game title: the Charmer title, a person/role, not responsibility for charm as an abstract quality
ru.не будешь свободен: Negated future availability: you will not be free/available. Do not silently drop не or translate as when you are free; preserve any conditional clause, even if the source sounds unusual
ru.никуда не спешу: Idiomatic I'm in no hurry / I'm not in a rush; not literal travel or being in a hurry anywhere
ru.отказа: In a request to formulate an отказ кому-либо, the named person may be the recipient of the refusal, not its author. Resolve that direction from the full grammar/context; do not turn turning someone down into receiving their refusal
ru.вот оно что: Recognition of an explanation: I see / so that's what you mean / so that's how it works. Do not translate recognition as unexplained surprise about a physical object
ru.так хорошо: In a turn acknowledging an explanation, colloquial так хорошо may omit the comma in так, хорошо: okay then / alright. Use that's so good only when the context actually expresses praise or pleasure
ru.в плане?: As a short clarification question, В плане? means What do you mean? / In what sense?, not Are you on the plan? Use a literal plan meaning only if the sentence explicitly describes a plan
ru.отвечаю: Standalone emphatic Отвечаю after a claim means I swear / I'm serious / you can count on it. It does not mean I'm responding in that usage. Keep the literal replying meaning only for an actual act of answering
ru.сказала, что есть: In reported existence or possession, что есть means that there is / that I do have one when the object is omitted. Do not invent I had eaten: past-tense eating would use ела or поела, not есть. Preserve contrast such as наоборот (the opposite / on the contrary)
ru.дворецкий: The role/title butler: Butler when capitalized as an affectionate title. Do not replace this ordinary noun with an invented person's name such as Jeeves
ru.мисс: Miss is a title. When a title plus quoted nickname is followed by a third-person verb such as предприняла, the title is the sentence subject (Has Miss ... done anything?), not a vocative addressing you. Follow verb person, not an assumed listener
ru.член: Polysemous noun: member in a group or organization; penis in anatomical or sexual context. Choose from the actual context, never replace an anatomical referent with a person. In anatomy, головка means the head/glans of that organ, not the head of the tongue. Keep the actor, recipient, and body-part ownership consistent
ru.не горит: not urgent / no rush when discussing timing
ru.сборка: software build in software or bot context
ru.отпишусь: I'll get back to you / let you know
ru.Да, пожалуйста: Yes, please: accepting an offer or requesting something, not granting permission with Sure, go ahead
ru.Пойдет?: When asking whether the preceding wording or result is acceptable: Will that do? / Is that okay? Do not invent a dating invitation. Use a motion meaning only if the source context describes going somewhere
ru.Пойдёт?: When asking whether the preceding wording or result is acceptable: Will that do? / Is that okay? Do not invent a dating invitation. Use a motion meaning only if the source context describes going somewhere
ru.стоит поменять: Impersonal suggestion: it would be worth changing / it is worth changing. Do not invent you should or an owner your/my where the source does not name one
ru.сделаю: First-person singular future: I will make/do. With сама, the female speaker does it herself: I will make it myself, never you do it yourself. тебе is the recipient for you, not the acting subject
ru.сама: Emphatic reflexive: resolve its subject from verb person and sentence grammar. With first-person сделаю and omitted я, use myself; with second-person сделаешь use yourself. Do not attach it automatically to тебе or хочешь
ru.спс: Common chat abbreviation for спасибо: thanks. о спс means oh, thanks
ru.в майн го: Casual gaming invitation: let's play Minecraft / let's hop into Minecraft, not go to Maine or a literal mine
ru.р4: In an alliance/game conversation, rank-four officers: R4s / R4 officers. Preserve the rank identifier, not a road or unrelated code
ru.дописаться: Reach/get through to someone by messaging them, not finish writing
